data.narrative:
Quantum Source is a Series A quantum computing company that has raised approximately $77M to date. The quantum computing sector contains a sparse peer universe of 3 public companies (IONQ, RGTI, QBTS) and 8 private competitors including Quantinuum, IonQ, PsiQuantum, D-Wave Quantum, and SandboxAQ.

Due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables within the quantum computing sector—no peers meeting narrow filter thresholds of three or more datapoints—peer-median valuation was not applicable. Accordingly, stage-progression analysis was employed as the primary method. Using total capital raised of $77M as a proxy for earlier valuation and applying a standard Series A-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 2.0x yields an implied valuation of $154M.

The triangulated valuation range, derived from the single applicable method, is $131M (low) to $177M (high), with a median of $154M. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the 2.0x multiplier for quantum computing specifically—given the sector's nascent stage and heterogeneous technical approaches—and the lack of direct peer benchmarking to validate this step-up assumption. A broader competitive assessment or evidence of differentiated technical capabilities or commercial traction would improve confidence in this range.
